command:
set -eu
PROOF_DIR=$(mktemp -d /run/os-comparison-ca-proof.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.key" "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.csr" "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.crt" "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.ext"; rmdir "$PROOF_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes \
  -keyout "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.key" \
  -out "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.csr" \
  -subj "/CN=ca-trust-proof.$NODE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf '%s\n' \
  '[ leaf ]' \
  'basicConstraints = critical, CA:false' \
  'keyUsage = critical, digitalSignature, keyEncipherment' \
  'extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth' \
  "subjectAltName = DNS:ca-trust-proof.$NODE_NAME" > "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.ext"
openssl x509 -req \
  -in "$PROOF_DIR/leaf.csr" \
  -CA /etc/pki/CA/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -CAkey /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -set_serial 1001 -days 1 -sha256 \
